messages.subject: job opportunity - Bioinformatics Scientist
messages.body_plain:
I'm looking for a Ph.D.-level bioinformatician to join my group at the
Great Lakes Bioenergy Research Center in Madison, WI, USA.  I need
someone who has experience analyzing high-throughput data such as
transcriptomics, metabolomics etc.  Familiarity with next-gen
sequencing data will be a big plus.  Data management and database
design skills are also desirable.  See further details and application
instructions at http://www.ohr.wisc.edu/pvl/pv_065583.html

Thanks.

Yury

messages.subject: sub-setting data frames?
messages.body_plain:
hello,

i am hoping someone could give advice on a problem.  I have two
dataframes and i want to compare them to find the intersect,
subtraction, etc.  below is some simple data, my progress so far and
questions.  Thanks in advance for any help:

#sample data
id1 <- c('patient1', 'patient2', 'patient3')
id2 <- c('patient1', 'patient2', 'patient4')
coefficient1 <- c(1, 1, 1)
coefficient2 <- c(1, 2, 3)
df1 <- data.frame(id=id1, coefficient=coefficient1);
df2 <- data.frame(id=id2, coefficient=coefficient2);

IdxToDelete <- setdiff(df1$id, df2$id);
#how to find rows from df1 where df1$id is in IdxToDelete?
#i would expect this to return the row where Id='patient3'

IdxToInsert <- setdiff(df2$id, df1$id);
#how to find rows in df2 where df1$id is in IdxToInsert?
#i would expect this to return the row where Id='patient4'

IdxToUpdate <- intersect(df1$id, df2$id);
#this one is more complex.  first, how to find rows in df1 or df2
where df1$id is in IdxToUpdate?
#i would expect this to return the rows where Id='patient1' or 'patient2'
#then how do i most efficiently find any records where the coefficient
on these records differs between the two datasets?

messages.subject: Re: sub-setting data frames?
messages.body_plain:
NAs are always a pain.  You need to include suitable use of is.na <http://is.na>().  Something like the following:

  toGet <- (!is.na <http://is.na>(vec1) & is.na <http://is.na>(vec2)) | (is.na <http://is.na>(vec1) & !is.na <http://is.na>(vec2)) | (!is.na <http://is.na>(vec1) & !is.na <http://is.na>(vec2) & vec1 != vec2)

karl

messages.subject: Splus for 64bit Windows7 ?
messages.body_plain:
Dear-

I am a long times user of Splus 2000 under 32 bit XP.

After I change 32bit XP to 64 bit Windows 7, my previous Splus cannot
be installed in the new 64bit Windows7.

1) Is there any way for me to use the Splus in the 64 bit Windows7?

2) In many case, most 32bit-based software can be run under 64 bit
OS.  There might be some way.

3) Is there any link for me to search any further detail on 32 bit
Splus program in 64 bit OS?

Thanks in advance.
